cor.text: Cost of revenue increased $157.0 to $499.9 for the three months ended June 30, 2026 compared to $342.9 for the three months ended June 30, 2025. The increase was primarily due to content license and data center lease costs that support our budding Truth+ platform.

rd.heading: Research and development expense
rd.text: Research and development expense decreased $4,834.7 to $8,206.3 for the three months ended June 30, 2026 compared to $13,041.0 for the three months ended June 30, 2025. The decrease was primarily driven by lower stock-based compensation expense of $2,930.1 in the second quarter of 2026 compared to $8,048.2 of stock-based compensation expense recorded in the second quarter of 2025.

sm.heading: Sales and marketing expense
sm.text: Sales and marketing expense increased $1,422.8 to $1,978.8 for the three months ended June 30, 2026 compared to $556.0 for the three months ended June 30, 2025. The increase was primarily driven by increased expenses for user engagement on Truth Social and our ad placement platform on Truth+.

nonop.heading: Interest expense
nonop.text: Interest expense increased $7,630.0 to $11,735.1 for the three months ended June 30, 2026 compared to $4,105.1 for the three months ended June 30, 2025. The increase in interest expense was attributable to the accreted interest on the loan assumed as a result of the WCT acquisition and our $1,000,000.0 convertible notes facility issued in May 2025.

ocf.heading: Net Cash Used in Operating Activities
ocf.text: Net cash used in operating activities for the six months ended June 30, 2026 was $13,676.9, $6,242.2 higher than $7,434.7 used in operating activities during the six months ended June 30, 2025. The increase in cash used in operating activities was primarily driven by increased legal expenses tied to recently concluded legal matters related to events prior to our merger with DWAC in 2024, along with a shift in our bitcoin option strategy from receiving premiums paid in cash to receiving premiums paid in bitcoin.

da.heading: Depreciation and amortization
da.text: Depreciation and amortization expense increased $35.6 to $1,869.1 for the three months ended June 30, 2026 compared to $1,833.5 for the three months ended June 30, 2025. The increase in depreciation and amortization expense was due to the acquisition of software and hardware utilized to place our CDN into service as part of our launch of streaming video through Truth+.

wc.text: Our primary short-term requirements for liquidity and capital are to fund general working capital and to invest in our strategic growth initiatives. We currently seek to (1) grow our initial product, Truth Social; (2) increase additional product offerings and services, including through further development of our streaming technology platform, Truth+; (3) pursue strategic acquisitions and/or partnerships, and (4) potentially refinance our convertible notes if noteholders elect to exercise their right to cash repayment in November 2026. We intend to fund these activities through a combination of deploying cash on hand, monetizing certain other assets, generating advertising, subscription, and fee-based revenues, issuing equity, issuing debt, and/or selling stock pursuant to the SEPA (as defined below).

net sales.heading: Revenues
net sales.text: Revenues increased $786.4 to $1,669.7 for the three months ended June 30, 2026 compared to revenue of $883.3 for the three months ended June 30, 2025. The increase was attributable to provisioning of advertising services related to a barter agreement, subscriptions to the Patriot Package offered as part of our beta launch of Truth+, and management fees earned from our Truth.Fi ETF offerings, partially offset by a decrease in advertising revenue on our Truth Social platform.

Pursuant to the Merger Agreement, and subject to the terms and conditions set forth therein, upon the Closing, DWAC Merger Sub merged with and into TMTG, with TMTG surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Digital World.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Short-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for the cash they will return: financial.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Other current liabilities
lines.why: Other operating items due within a year: operating.

lines.name: Current portion of long-term debt
lines.why: Borrowed money falling due within a year: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
